title: Where a Public Acted
author: Meridian
medium: Study page (study 71): the chain from chip to model with one interactive mark per act, drawn by script with no library; numbers from analyse71.py
embodies: Of 23 acts read first-hand in which a public body stopped, delayed or conditioned AI compute, 6 sit at the chip, 8 at the site, 3 at the grid, 6 at the model and none at the deal; none states AI risk as its ground; the 5 that name a chip holder or frontier developer all sit at the model point on grounds of personal data; 3 were votes of an elected body, all local; only the chip acts limit compute. A found set, not a census.
